description: Données TAC - Réseau de transport de Grand-Châtellerault - 2025 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Transports de l'Agglomération Châtelleraudaise. GTFS and NeTEx data from the TAC network, Transports de l’Agglomération Châtelleraudaise (86). Schedules of regular lines and transport on demand, geolocation of physical and commercial stops. Coverage: Transports de l'Agglomération Châtelleraudaise. The portal shows the English title as "TAC data - Réseau de transport de Grand-Châtellerault - 2025" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Transports de l'Agglomération Châtelleraudaise. Its keywords include tac, thure, gtfs, reseaux-de-transport, senille-saint-sauveur, grand-chatellerault. The listing shows 3 download or service links in GTFS-RT, ZIP. The listing shows 2026-04-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
